raw_text:
name: remove-phase
description: Remove an unstarted future phase, delete its directory, renumber subsequent phases, and commit the change as the historical record.
Read all files referenced by the invoking prompt's execution_context before starting.

<step name="parse_arguments">
Argument: phase number (integer or decimal). Examples: `/gsd:remove-phase 17` → 17; `/gsd:remove-phase 16.1` → 16.1.
If absent:
ERROR: Phase number required
Usage: /gsd:remove-phase <phase-number>
Example: /gsd:remove-phase 17
</step>

<step name="init_context">
INIT=$(node "./.claude/get-shit-done/bin/gsd-tools.cjs" init phase-op "${target}")
if [[ "$INIT" == <REDACTED_USER>:* ]]; then INIT=$(cat "${INIT#<REDACTED_USER>:}"); fi
Extract `phase_found`, `phase_dir`, `phase_number`, `commit_docs`, `roadmap_exists`. Read STATE.md and ROADMAP.md for current position.
</step>

<step name="validate_future_phase">
Compare target with current phase in STATE.md; target must be greater.
If target <= current phase:
ERROR: Cannot remove Phase {target}
Only future phases can be removed:
Current phase: {current}
Phase {target} is current or completed
To abandon current work, use /gsd:pause-work instead.
</step>

<step name="confirm_removal">
Present and confirm:
Removing Phase {target}: {Name}
Delete: .planning/phases/{target}-{slug}/
Renumber all subsequent phases
Update: ROADMAP.md, STATE.md
Wait for confirmation.
</step>

<step name="execute_removal">
**Delegate the entire removal operation to gsd-tools:**
RESULT=$(node "./.claude/get-shit-done/bin/gsd-tools.cjs" phase remove "${target}")
If the phase has executed plans (SUMMARY.md files), gsd-tools will error. Use `--force` only if the user confirms:
RESULT=$(node "./.claude/get-shit-done/bin/gsd-tools.cjs" phase remove "${target}" --force)
CLI deletes directory; renumbers subsequent directories in reverse order and files (PLAN.md, SUMMARY.md, etc.); updates ROADMAP.md (section, references, dependencies) and STATE.md (phase count). Extract `removed`, `directory_deleted`, `renamed_directories`, `renamed_files`, `roadmap_updated`, `state_updated`.
</step>

<step name="commit">
Stage and commit:
node "./.claude/get-shit-done/bin/gsd-tools.cjs" commit "chore: remove phase {target} ({original-phase-name})" --files .planning/
Commit message preserves the historical record.
</step>

<step name="completion">
Report:
Phase {target} ({original-name}) removed.
Deleted: .planning/phases/{target}-{slug}/
Renumbered: {N} directories and {M} files
Updated: ROADMAP.md, STATE.md
Committed: chore: remove phase {target} ({original-name})
Offer `/gsd:progress` or continuing with current phase.

Don't remove completed phases (have SUMMARY.md files) without --force
Don't remove current or past phases
Don't manually renumber — use `gsd-tools phase remove` which handles all renumbering
Don't add "removed phase" notes to STATE.md — git commit is the record
Don't modify completed phase directories

Phase removal is complete when:
[ ] Target phase validated as future/unstarted
[ ] `gsd-tools phase remove` executed successfully
[ ] Changes committed with descriptive message
[ ] User informed of changes
</step>
